_readme: Ready-to-use POST /api/plan request bodies. Date must stay within 2025-2030; time must be 05:00-24:00 Cairo time. Each entry maps to a real Cairo metro route covered by the 2018 GTFS + frequencies.txt.

routes.name: Abbassiya → Cairo Stadium (M3, no transfer)
routes.description: Short eastbound M3 hop — the baseline smoke test from the API docs.

routes.name: Attaba → Adly Mansour (M3, full eastern run)
routes.description: Full length of Metro Line 3 eastbound — longest M3 trip available.

routes.name: Sadat (Tahrir) → Helwan (M1 southbound)
routes.description: Long M1 southbound run from downtown to Helwan terminus.

routes.name: Sadat (Tahrir) → New El-Marg (M1 northbound)
routes.description: Long M1 northbound run from downtown to New El-Marg terminus.

routes.name: Shubra El-Kheima → Giza (M2, full cross-city run)
routes.description: Full length of Metro Line 2 — crosses downtown via Mubarak/Sadat interchange.

routes.name: Shubra El-Kheima → El-Mounib (M2, end to end)
routes.description: Full M2 from northern terminus to southern terminus.

routes.name: New El-Marg → Adly Mansour (M1 + M3, 1 transfer at Abbassiya)
routes.description: Requires walking transfer between M1 and M3 near Abbassiya. Tests multi-leg routing.

routes.name: El-Maadi → Sadat (M1, southside to downtown)
routes.description: Commuter route from Maadi residential area to Tahrir/downtown.

routes.name: Bus-only route test
routes.description: Forces bus routing only — useful to verify bus lines are loaded from frequencies.txt.

routes.name: All transit modes (bus + subway)
routes.description: Lets OTP pick the best combination of bus and metro. Tests that multi-mode queries deduplicate correctly.
